proposals.title: Expanded cap 2->3, RAM-gated
proposals.change: EXPANDED_NEWS_PARENT_FLEET_CAP 2->3 in longrun_scheduling_policy.py, guarded by a free-RAM precheck at claim time (only grant the 3rd expansion slot when free physical RAM >= 10GB, i.e. > commit_reservation_gb headroom).
proposals.rationale: Claim-selection only; never touches verdict/gate logic. Raises burst ceiling ~50% and cuts child pending wait (median 8.3h, max 85.8h).
proposals.cost_of_waiting: Low right now (cap not binding). High during the next expansion burst.
proposals.blast_radius: <=1 extra terminal; short-flow reserve drops 4->3 on a 10-terminal fleet only while all news slots busy. Rollback: QM_DISABLE_LONGRUN_SCHEDULING_CAP=1 or revert constant.
proposals.recommendation: Implement as a dormant burst valve, but treat as secondary; it does not reduce the NUMBER of expansions.

proposals.title: Tighten expansion whole-child timeout budget
proposals.change: Reduce child timeout_min from 11080/22860 (7.7-15.9 days) to ~900 min (15h > observed max exec 13.2h + margin). Per-cell 10800s (3h) stays; it is not binding (avg cell ~11 min).
proposals.rationale: 4 expansion children INFRA_FAIL; an over-provisioned budget lets a hung/silent-abort child hold a capped slot for days. A tight budget reaps it into requeue faster, freeing 1 of 2 capped slots.
proposals.cost_of_waiting: Each hung child can idle a scarce expansion slot up to the current 7.7-15.9 day budget.
proposals.blast_radius: Reaper timing only; no verdict impact. Rollback: revert the budget.

proposals.title: Lineage-rank claim ordering for news expansions
proposals.change: Apply the existing priority_track/append_only_rerun lineage rank (already used for Q07/Q08 reruns and replacement parents) to expansion-child claim ordering so Q10-lock-blocking counter-critical lineages take the 2 (or 3) expansion slots before FIFO rows.
proposals.rationale: The 0/25 census is gated on Q10 locks; prioritising lineages that unblock the census beats arrival order.
proposals.blast_radius: Claim ordering only; no cap change, no verdict change.

proposals.title: Pre-check to skip expansion when material fires only from an inert channel
proposals.evidence: 17/17 material expansions had max_affected_entries=0 (entry-block channel inert); 6/8 recent locks chose OFF; sign_or_gate_flip degenerate (0/5) under inert seeds; selection uses target-compliance column only; 8-cell ran compliance NONE for DXZ targets (provenance anomaly).

sub_options.D1_provenance_fix: Correct the 8-cell to run the ACTUAL target compliance (DXZ) instead of NONE. Then the 8-cell target column is decision-complete and the 29-cell expansion (which only adds non-selected compliance columns) can be deferred/made lazy - removing ~all expansion cost for the current target. Highest leverage; ROT because it changes what the gate computes.
sub_options.D2_threshold_recal: Re-derive material_effect thresholds for the inert-seed contract-v3 world: the sign_or_gate_flip 3-of-5 gate is meaningless when seeds are inert, and delta_net_r/delta_profit_factor fire at 0 blocked entries. Tighten so exit-side numerical deltas do not force 29-cell expansions that 75% conclude OFF. ROT because it changes gate criteria.

proposals.statement: Any change to WHEN expansion fires, the material_effect thresholds, or the compliance the 8-cell runs is a gate-criteria/contract change = ROT, OWNER only. A/B/C are scheduling/claim/timeout and touch no verdict logic.
